stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 57%/17%, Mr. Action Jackson 79%/41%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 87% / 53%, The Mahomies 34% / 6.2%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🏈 100-YARD RUSH: Ruffing the Passer ripped off a 26-yard run last week, 29% → 55% playoff odds. Hit the hole and never looked back.
🔮 Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 4.70 pts.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 67% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 44%).
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane has all but locked up the #1 seed (99.5%).
🎯 11 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Claremont In Yo Stace! right on the line (49%).
🎲 Claremont In Yo Stace! is rolling with 2 kickers and 3 TEs (LaPorta, Andrews and Strange). It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
⚔️ Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies is projected to finish just 4.70 pts apart.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
